[center][font=Georgia]This mod adds bamboo as a new kind of wild tree into game.[/font][/center]
[center][font=Georgia] [/font][/center]
[center][font=Georgia]Bamboo grows in any season and spreads quickly, but never drops seeds when you chop it or shake it.
When chopped down,  they yield Bamboo Strips, which can be chopped to product woods by Wood Chopper.
When tapped, they yield Fresh Bamboo Juice every day in spring, or every 2 day in other seasons.
 
The seeds (bamboo shoot) can be purchased from the Traveling Cart in spring & summer.
Also,  it can be pickled to make Sour Bamboo Shoots.

[/font][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54949/54949-1793629888-56100416.png[/img]
